item.title: Sanders Endorses Nixon After Florida Primary Win
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders endorsed Florida Democratic Senate nominee Angie Nixon on Thursday, following her upset victory over the party establishment.

item.title: Texas and Iowa Senate races tighten ahead of midterms
item.description: Recent projections show the Senate races in Texas and Iowa, typically Republican states, are now too close to call as the midterms approach.

item.title: DHS responds to requests from Mullin's congressional allies
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin is gaining a reputation for assisting former colleagues in Congress, according to reports.

item.title: Vance raises $5 million at Hamptons fundraiser
item.description: Vice President Vance hosted a fundraiser in Southampton, N.Y., for young Republican donors, raising over $5 million, according to Axios.
